answer: Sock puppets share hardware, so make them prove separate clocks. Each new key must sign a raven beacon every 7 minutes for 2 days, timed against 5 random peers; a quill digest of the signing latencies is posted per key. Keys whose latency jitter correlates above 0.9 with another key are tied by a thread and split a single reward. Joining costs a 40 POA bond plus the uptime. Anyone can recompute correlations from the public digests. If a genuine pair is wrongly tied, they appeal by running on two regions for one epoch; a failed appeal burns 12 POA.
